content: Yasu zǝ Yukhan Dadak para Ud
Udzala kǝ Yasu ǝn tǝkhatǝra lava kǝ furakh sar kǝlatǝm mits, ka ɗuwars ad yanen kǝ vak, tsuguna ka dǝgal tsin da tsagatǝrdu tsaga zǝ tlǝkhatǝra lav Yazhigǝl kǝ dlǝmdla kǝsakhe khǝrza dǝ yanen kǝ kǝs.
Tsǝna kǝ Yukhan dadak para ud ǝn zaw ad dǝgakhe tsǝn mana Kristu, ka ɓǝlandal ad chalǝm Zar ɓǝlakh sar da vak sar.
Nǝv itar kǝ Yasu, “Kwara kǝnkhe kwar,” “Kha naghek dadake tsǝn kwara Yukhan dadak para ud da sǝgdagh na, nagha da gwit tlǝrna ud sikha khǝkǝndi?”
Nǝv Yasu tsitar, “Damaks da kwarara kwara kǝ Yukhan ad dǝge tsǝna kur zǝ dǝge nǝgha kur.
Ngulfakha a ngwarǝf di tsitar, ǝn dǝga ghwurɗikakha, li kuza fǝcha a mbakharu fidgiɗ, ǝn tsǝnatsǝna tǝngakh, a gwidǝn tsaya tǝrǝfud kǝ li tsa amtsǝgan, ka kwaratǝra lav zǝɗan ud kǝ talagakh.
Dadak bark liye kwal guyakdu lig wirva dǝge ǝn mana kǝ.”

Madv zar bǝla Yukhan ǝn daks, ka farsa Yasu kwara tǝra lava kǝ udakh ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ Yukhan kwarne, “Dala tsǝkur da vak Yukhan ǝn tǝghal, da kuram ǝn kurana wuɗa tsǝn nakur nǝgha nǝghi? A dal da vaz tsǝɓ tsǝɓan kǝ mase ǝn kaɗa fuɗ nagh kur?
Tsa dal da vaz uɗa kuri? Ude chaɗfkhai ǝn kadlang khwaran naghf kur? Liye chaɗfkhai ndǝkyana ǝn gidǝn tǝ gǝlvakh shikakh itar fǝka.
Kwara make kwar, tsa dal da vaz uɗa kuri? Tlayang nagha? Ndǝk yanen, ai tsuguna a nǝgha tsǝkur dadake a malgan ad Tlayang.
Tsa Yukhan dadake tsa vindzava lav ǝn tǝghǝr tsin ǝn kaɗkaɗ kwarne,

content.text: “ ‘Da ɓǝlaɓǝla ka ad zǝr ɓǝlara kǝ dakho ǝn tǝ vuk.

content: Ən tekha kura tǝkha kǝ, na nuse taɓa yig zǝr ai do da tǝ Yukhan dadak para ud dǝ ndanga bi. Ai tsugun, dadake khǝɗikan ǝn tlǝksa gharazhigǝla a malgan ad Yukhan kǝ ndang.
Tsif ǝnt sarte tsa kwardu Yukhan dadak para ud ad lav Yazhigǝl tangw da tina kǝ sart. A wushif ghǝr kǝ tlǝksa gharazhigǝl, li tsiyara mǝkǝn kǝ udakha ǝn nagh pǝrd tlǝksa Yazhigǝl itar dǝ ndzǝɗ.
Lave a tsagdu nzdikha nzdikh Musa zǝ kaɗkaɗ tlayangakh daghan a kwarga itar lav ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ tlǝksen kǝda sǝgdagh kǝ Yukhan
Da khayanǝf kur dǝ lav tara, Yukhan ai tsǝn kwarud lavǝn teghǝra, in Ili na tsǝn kwarud da sǝgdagh.
Tsǝna dadak tlim ad lave kwarud.
“Da kura dǝ war ka udakh zamani? Ghila zar mbisane ǝn giɗǝn te ɓala kasuk ǝn ɗakhva kǝ da man sakw ǝn tatak tar itar zǝ kwar lava kwarne,
Sodagh kǝ Yukhana, tsa nabǝn zu dǝg zuwakh zǝ khǝɓ itsera kǝ digitakh bi, ‘Ka sǝɗikw wurdu ǝn vǝghtsino nǝv itar.’

Wur sodagh Zer Uda, ǝn zuwa zuwa zǝ khǝɓa khǝɓ, ‘Vaza dǝ udan na. Mbǝlv zǝn ɗayuɗay, zǝ tsaghw li chau khadama zǝ li man khepo nǝv itar.’ Tlǝre ǝn mana udan in da mǝdlan ad kwalemleme a bara Yazhigǝl.”
Kǝsakhe kalwal kǝ pǝlghǝr
Udakhe ǝn kǝsakhe tsa manakhga Yasu ad dǝg ndawakakh ǝn kǝs tar, a kalwala itar kǝ pǝlghǝr, ka tavatǝrghǝr ad di.

Ɗangwa tsǝkur, Korasin. Ɗangwa tsǝkur, Betsaid. Da tsa a manakhgǝn kǝs ya Taya zǝ Sidom ud ad dǝg ndawakhe a manavǝn vakur, tsa pǝlga itar ghǝr gulyan, tsa ɗaiva itar ad Ligwit ngǝz zǝ ɗaiva fǝts ǝn tǝ vǝghakh tar.
Ai tǝkha kura tǝkha kǝ, da ziwardala kǝ udakh ya Taya zǝ Sidon ud tǝghǝr tsǝkur fitsa man taka lav.

Kha tsugun Kafarnakhum, da ghǝr tsǝkhǝn kurana da ɓǝkha ɓakhud da gharazhigǝla? Əmma tsǝkhara, da kǝɗkh dagh da vak liye ǝn tǝ fayud. Da tsa mangǝn Sadom ud ad dǝg ndawakakhe tsa mangud ǝn vakur, tsa dla itar sakhkan.
Ai tǝkha kura tǝkha kǝ, da ziwardala kǝ udakh ya Sadom ud tǝghǝr tsǝkur fitsa man taka lav.
Ausǝgam da vakara kǝ mbǝladu fǝtav

Ən tǝ yanen kǝ sart a kwarga Yasu kwarne, “Ən kwara kha us ka Dada, Dadzikan dadak gharazhigǝl zǝ khay, wirva a ɓǝgharna kha dǝgakhana kǝ liye kwalemlem zǝ liye ǝn tsa lav, ka mǝdlatǝrankh kǝ zar mbisan liye kwal tsa lav.
Khwara Dada, wirva ndǝk yanen kǝ manakhal.
“A ba ka Dadar ad digitakh daghan. Na ude tsa Zǝr bi uk Dad, tsuguna na ude tsa Dad bi uk Zǝr, zǝ udakhe a naghga Zǝren tsugun ad mǝdlatǝramǝdl.
“Ausǝgam da vakar, daghanure a suvgan dǝ zǝɓ kadlang ɗimɗiman, da bakura fǝtava kǝ.
Ɓamǝf ɓa changlagara da tǝ pepur. Tsagam tsagǝn vakar, wirva ka dadak tsukwana ghǝr kǝ man digitakh kǝ, zǝ dadak gulandagh ghǝr kǝ ǝn rǝv, ka da mbǝladu mbǝla kur fǝtava kǝ ghǝrur.
Changlagara na ba ɗimɗim bi, kadlangara tsuguna chafchaf.”
